choices.reason: No rule uniquely selects a candidate: the paper names no primary outcome, and its abstract reports several creativity dimensions without ranking them. All candidates provide participant-level means, SDs and counts for the same sample and arms; session selection cannot resolve the outcome tie, and Table 4's pooled summaries are outside the supplied candidate set.
choices.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 2, research question 1; p. 1, Abstract; pp. 8-9, Tables 4-5.
choices.quote: Creativity was evaluated along five dimensions: fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration, and novelty.
